name: Eclipse: Special Forces
source:
All men have been wiped from the Earth. It marks the dawn of a new world.
Under the blessing of La, the one true god, women have peacefully ruled the world for over a millennium. 

Guarded by Eclipse, a special forces unit composed solely of women gifted with Supernatural Powers, peace seemed eternal—until now. 

With the sudden emergence of a mysterious cult called ‘Apep’, the world’s hidden truths begin to resurface. 

As Haesu, a dedicated member within Eclipse, you're drawn into a web of conspiracy, betrayal, and forgotten histories.

Amidst growing chaos, will you guide Haesu to uncover the hidden truth?Every choice you make shapes not only Haesu’s destiny but the future of the world itself

Can you face the truth—amid love, desire, and spilled blood?
Your journey awaits.


[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3280020/Eclipse__Special_Forces/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
所有人类都已从地球上消失。它标志着一个新世界的黎明。
在独一真神拉的祝福下，女性和平地统治了世界一千多年。

在“日蚀”（一支完全由具有超自然力量的女性组成的特种部队）的守护下，和平似乎是永恒的——直到现在。

随着一个名为“Apep”的神秘邪教的突然出现，世界隐藏的真相开始重新浮出水面。

作为Eclipse的忠实成员Haesu，你被卷入了一张充满阴谋、背叛和被遗忘的历史的网络中。

在日益混乱的情况下，你会引导海秀揭开隐藏的真相吗？你所做的每一个选择不仅决定了海秀的命运，也决定了世界本身的未来

你能在爱、欲望和鲜血中面对真相吗？
你的旅程正在等待着。


[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3280020/Eclipse__Special_Forces/]Steam[/url]]
